source_snapshot.procedure: Install M.2 controllers into M.2 PCIe slots and inspect tight/loose fit plus chassis-cover interference.

historical_reviews.deepseek: Correctly rejects remote automation but under-specifies the full mechanical matrix and safety procedure.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: Preserves tactile/visual authority and adds controlled hardware handling plus per-slot evidence.
historical_reviews.related_cases: OS enumeration may corroborate electrical detection but cannot prove insertion force, fastener engagement or cover clearance.
historical_reviews.v3_1: Physical inspection remains operator-owned; software evidence cannot replace tactile acceptance.

original_test_intent: Verify every approved M.2 controller can be installed in every supported M.2 PCIe slot with correct keying, seating, fastening and chassis/thermal clearance and without excessive looseness, force or interference.
original_method: With power removed and ESD controls, a qualified operator installs each approved controller/slot combination using specified standoff/screw/torque, photographs fit and clearance, restores the system and optionally corroborates enumeration after boot.
manual_activity: Qualified hardware operator powers down/removes power, applies ESD/torque procedure, installs every approved combination and records tactile/visual fit and clearance.
required_inputs: M.2 controller model/length/key and supported slot matrix
Service manual, shutdown/power-removal, ESD and torque requirements
Known-good restoration/recovery and optional storage enumeration tools
safety_requirements: Remove power and use ESD controls before handling
Verify key, standoff, screw and thermal arrangement before insertion
Stop on excessive force/looseness, wrong slot, flex, stripped screw, interference, damage or unsafe condition
Do not continue cycling a suspect connector or power on with loose hardware
Restore and inspect the known-good configuration before boot
agent_execution_scope: Organize operator-supplied identity/photos and optional read-only enumeration
Correlate each observation to controller/slot combination
Do not handle hardware, infer mechanical fit from software, auto-reseat/power-cycle or issue verdict
engineer_actions: Approve mechanical matrix and service procedure
Ensure qualified operator judges every combination
Review evidence and issue per-combination PASS/FAIL/BLOCKED

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Correctly identifies that no command can establish mechanical fit.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: No remote command substitutes for tactile/visual inspection; optional lspci/nvme/health output may corroborate electrical function after safe assembly.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Controller installation, tight/loose fit, chassis-cover interference, all-controller smooth fit and 5/0 timing fields are preserved.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Execute a controlled physical controller-by-slot fit matrix with per-combination mechanical and clearance evidence.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds exact matrix, hardware safety and traceable evidence.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: No tactile or visual criterion is replaced by enumeration.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Insertion force is partly subjective; service limits and qualified operator judgment are authoritative.

project_override_considerations: Only combinations approved by the mechanical/thermal design matrix are exercised; unsupported key/length/slot combinations are not forced.
expected_evidence: Keying, seating, alignment, force/looseness, screw and cover/thermal/cable clearance observations
Damage/interference disposition and optional post-boot enumeration/health

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Master, DeepSeek and GPT V2 agree that mechanical fit is a manual physical fact.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The case is manual rather than inherently blocked when the SUT, matrix and qualified operator are available.

review_improvement: Expands a generic visual check into an auditable controller-by-slot mechanical matrix while preserving manual authority.
independent_technical_reasoning: Electrical enumeration proves contact but not that the board is correctly supported, unwarped, fastened or clear of the chassis cover and thermal stack. Those failures can appear only under physical assembly, so direct tactile/visual inspection is indispensable.
